# `discardedRunPromiseToRunFork`

Detects discarded Promises from Effect runPromise runners that should use runFork

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Correctness |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377179` |
| Language Service name | `discardedRunPromiseToRunFork` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/discarded-run-promise-to-run-fork` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

const program = Effect.log("server started").pipe(
  Effect.andThen(Effect.fail(new Error("bind failed")))
)

void Effect.runPromise(program)
/**
     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(discarded-run-promise-to-run-fork): The Promise returned by `Effect.runPromise` is discarded, so any failure or defect becomes an unhandled rejection. Use `Effect.runFork` to run it fire-and-forget as a Fiber.
*/
```

## Language Service Configuration

See the [Language Service setup guide](../../README.md#installation) for installation instructions.

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/schema.json",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "@effect/language-service",
        "diagnosticSeverity": {
          "discardedRunPromiseToRunFork": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

See the [Oxlint setup guide](../README.md#oxlint-setup) for installation and patching instructions.

```json

  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/oxlint-schema.json",
```
